name: wechat-codex
description: Set up and manage a local WeChat bridge for Codex tasks and completion notifications.

interface.shortDescription: One guided setup for WeChat control and Codex notifications.
interface.longDescription: A self-contained cross-platform installer for macOS, Linux, and Windows that configures local projects, connects a personal WeChat robot, starts the bridge automatically, and delivers durable Codex task notifications without manual config editing.
